verdict.rationale: Supabase explicitly documents self-hosting as a supported deployment model for full data control/compliance, with docs and CLI tooling (supabase init/start) to run the entire stack locally or in CI, corroborated by a hands-on probe confirming headless local provisioning. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full production self-hosted deployment (beyond local dev) and community reports raise friction/rough edges in self-hosting experience.
